title: Katamari Damacy
shortDescription: Keita Takahashi's delightfully surreal roll-em-up where a tiny prince rolls everyday items into giant cosmic balls.
historicalSignificance: Celebrated as an avant-garde artistic triumph demonstrating the joyous experimental spirit of PS2 gaming.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
